skill.summary: 网盘分享链接转存 - 完全自动化，发的链接就能下

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Fully automated cloud share downloader with expanded link support and streamlined user experience.

- Skill renamed to "cloud-share-downloader"
- Now fully automatic: Users just send a share link, and files are auto-saved and re-shared
- Supports more platforms: Baidu, Aliyun, Quark, 115, Bilibili, Douyin, Kuaishou
- No manual steps needed—send a link, get a new download link in return
- Improved clarity in support and instructions
